about.subtitle: We are Nopeiden Kuljetusten Ritarit AY — a Finnish delivery company committed to fast, reliable, and accessible logistics.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Nopeiden Kuljetusten Ritarit AY was founded with a simple mission — to make delivery services fast, affordable, and accessible to everyone in Finland.
story.p2: We believe that booking a delivery should be as easy as having a conversation. That is why we built Finland's first AI-powered delivery booking system that supports English, Finnish, and Russian.
story.p3: Whether you are sending a small package across the city or managing multiple deliveries for your business, we have got you covered.
